from datetime import datetime

transactions = """T1010 | 2024-05-07 | North | Garnet | 1,877.62 USD | paid
T1024 | 2024-05-09 | West | Delta | 624.52 EUR | paid
T1004 | 2024-05-10 | East | Birch | 4,721.28 USD | paid
T1020 | 2024-05-16 | North | Acme | 2,595.77 USD | paid
T1001 | 2024-05-27 | South | Cobalt | 4,209.73 EUR | pending
T1011 | 2024-06-07 | East | Garnet | 812.34 EUR | paid
T1006 | 2024-06-11 | East | Fjord | 4,775.17 USD | paid
T1019 | 2024-06-30 | East | Cobalt | 2,423.29 EUR | paid
T1007 | 2024-07-10 | South | Birch | 2,731.34 USD | paid
T1009 | 2024-07-13 | North | Delta | 2,877.08 USD | pending
T1003 | 2024-07-15 | North | Fjord | 3,335.13 USD | paid
T1002 | 2024-07-26 | South | Birch | 946.15 USD | paid
T1017 | 2024-07-31 | West | Cobalt | 1,185.08 USD | pending
T1023 | 2024-08-02 | North | Ember | 4,762.50 USD | paid
T1025 | 2024-08-04 | East | Cobalt | 4,357.38 USD | paid
T1014 | 2024-08-05 | East | Fjord | 4,553.51 USD | pending
T1000 | 2024-08-09 | West | Fjord | 3,882.71 USD | paid
T1021 | 2024-08-14 | South | Acme | 2,943.34 EUR | paid
T1012 | 2024-08-17 | South | Garnet | 137.35 EUR | paid
T1005 | 2024-08-24 | West | Cobalt | 2,766.41 EUR | paid
T1015 | 2024-08-26 | South | Acme | 1,905.50 EUR | refunded
T1018 | 2024-09-15 | East | Garnet | 1,007.01 USD | pending
T1026 | 2024-09-21 | North | Acme | 3,137.68 USD | paid
T1008 | 2024-09-23 | East | Garnet | 4,483.00 USD | paid
T1013 | 2024-09-23 | West | Garnet | 335.75 USD | paid
T1022 | 2024-09-27 | West | Ember | 316.67 EUR | paid
T1016 | 2024-10-01 | East | Birch | 2,604.56 USD | paid"""

exchange_rate = 1.16

# Parse transactions
data = []
for line in transactions.strip().split('\n'):
    parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split('|')]
    date = datetime.strptime(parts[1], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    customer = parts[3]
    amount_str = parts[4]
    status = parts[5]
    
    # Parse amount and currency
    amount_parts = amount_str.rsplit(' ', 1)
    amount = float(amount_parts[0].replace(',', ''))
    currency = amount_parts[1]
    
    data.append({
        'date': date,
        'customer': customer,
        'amount': amount,
        'currency': currency,
        'status': status
    })

# Filter by date range
start_date = datetime.strptime('2024-05-25', '%Y-%m-%d').date()
end_date = datetime.strptime('2024-07-19', '%Y-%m-%d').date()

filtered_data = [t for t in data if start_date <= t['date'] <= end_date]

# Calculate net amount for each customer
customer_totals = {}

for trans in filtered_data:
    customer = trans['customer']
    status = trans['status']
    
    # Only consider paid and refunded transactions
    if status == 'pending':
        continue
    
    # Convert to USD
    amount_usd = trans['amount']
    if trans['currency'] == 'EUR':
        amount_usd *= exchange_rate
    
    # Apply sign based on status
    if status == 'refunded':
        amount_usd = -amount_usd
    
    if customer not in customer_totals:
        customer_totals[customer] = 0
    customer_totals[customer] += amount_usd

# Find customer with highest net amount
max_customer = max(customer_totals, key=customer_totals.get)

print(f"ANSWER: {max_customer}")
